text: The reform narrows the levy to apply only to fire-damage insurance policies, aligning the funding mechanism with the specific peril FENZ addresses. It also simplifies the levy calculation by moving from 'amount insured' to 'sum insured', reflecting modern insurance contract structures. The reform process involved extensive consultation with stakeholders, including the insurance and property sectors, and is guided by principles of stability, equity, and predictability.

metadata.solution_name: Fire and Emergency New Zealand (FENZ) Funding Model Reform
